scope: Account-free local Gate 3 implementation checks; no provider account changes, live provider calls or remote deployment. SIP and authenticated WebRTC use isolated local peers.
proven: Additive session, availability, context and artifact control contracts with positive and malformed fixtures.
One durable conversation across bounded sessions, messages and artifact events.
Authenticated session lifecycle and namespaced projection into the pinned rvoip Orchestrator.
Two authenticated native peers exchange PCMU RTP through UCTP/QUIC datagrams in both directions.
Python and TypeScript use the installed native helper to exchange bounded raw PCMU over real UCTP/QUIC sessions.

One and four concurrent native sessions each sustain 60 seconds of duplex media with deterministic delay variation, deliberate source loss and concurrent reliable control traffic; forwarding p95 remains below 2.7 milliseconds.

An accepted Connect session attaches the pinned rvoip-vapi duplex adapter, injects bounded source-attributed context, exchanges PCMU both ways with a loopback provider and records the delivery outcome.
The pinned Vapi adapter's 20-case failure suite covers malformed and oversized replies, heartbeat and response deadlines, cancellation, remote close, shutdown and uncertain create behavior.
A local rvoip SIP endpoint enters through the configured authority boundary, exchanges media both ways with the fake Vapi agent, records transcript context and ends only its bounded Session.
An authenticated rvoip WebRTC client retains its signaling lease, negotiates Opus, exchanges transcoded media both ways with the fake Vapi agent and ends only its bounded Session.
SIP codec rejection, authenticated WebRTC admission limits and SIP/WebRTC/native cross-transport pairing have dedicated passing phases.
Managed external artifact bytes are integrity checked, protected by current conversation authority, included in backup manifest v2, restored with the database and guarded from orphan deletion.

The browser-only SDK entry and human test client cover conversation history, messages, files, availability, sessions and microphone voice without loading Node helper modules or persisting credentials.
Duplicated final Vapi transcripts are idempotently appended to the same durable conversation as source-attributed voice_transcript context items.
Rust, Python, TypeScript and HTTP/JSON expose the implemented Gate 3 control operations.
Real schema-6 and schema-7 databases migrate to schema 9 without losing representative Gate 1/2 state or artifact bytes.
open: Human audibility confirmation for the otherwise successful live native UCTP/QUIC-to-Vapi exchange.
Answered Telnyx SIP/PSTN audio and inbound reachability; outbound Digest signaling reached Ringing before the downstream network returned 603 network blocked.
Interactive browser microphone and audible playback qualification.
Live cross-channel context confirmation after answered PSTN and browser legs.
